description: `(event)="statement"` runs a template statement when a DOM event (or component output) fires.
The native event object, or the value emitted by a component output.
`(keydown.enter)`, `(keydown.control.s)`, `(keyup.escape)` only fire for the given key and modifiers.
`host: { '(window:resize)': 'measure()' }` listens on the host element, `window` or `document`. Replaces legacy `@HostListener`.
`input` fires on every keystroke; `change` fires when a text field loses focus after being edited.
